purpose: One explicit delegated engineering/verification task per registered agent role. Unconnected or non-persistent roles may be assigned or blocked, while runtime execution proof remains false until attributable lifecycle evidence exists.

execution_proof_policy.rule: A task is not marked runtime-proven unless attributable lifecycle evidence exists for the agent and task.
execution_proof_policy.enforcement: CI must fail closed if any registered agent lacks a task or any runtime-proof claim lacks lifecycle evidence.

tasks.objective: Repair and certify the agent delegation proof chain, including inventory validation and continuity evidence.
acceptance_criteria: all ten agents have exactly one task

tasks.objective: Adversarially review the delegation matrix, task ownership, and proof semantics for omissions or false-positive execution claims.
Coordinate the federated task queue and identify any blocked or unassigned agent work.
Review security, cloud, and multi-agent boundaries of the delegation/proof mechanism.
Inspect generated delegation and CI evidence artifacts for consistency and evidence-quality defects.
Verify the observable agent/command-center evidence surfaces and detect missing runtime status indicators.
acceptance_criteria: runtime state is not confused with configuration

tasks.objective: Independently validate the delegation inventory, regression behavior, and proof gate.
acceptance_criteria: runtime proof remains fail-closed when events are absent

tasks.objective: Maintain the capital-plane safety gate and reconcile any evidence without authorizing capital movement.
Supervise task decomposition, choose only relevant connected tools and skills, and independently cross-check material repository and policy changes without assuming persistent runtime access.
acceptance_criteria: role-scoped tool and skill policy is internally consistent
evidence claims distinguish registry configuration from actual runtime installation
no secret or capital authority is assigned

tasks.objective: After an authorized development device is connected, inspect the local runtime, safely clone or update the canonical AURELIA repository, run tests, and capture runtime evidence without access to production secrets or capital authority.
acceptance_criteria: authorized Desktop Commander device is connected and identity verified
canonical repository path and branch are confirmed
tests run in an isolated workspace and outputs are attributable
no production secrets or live order authority is exposed
